page: Microsoft Azure M176bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The instance features 176 dedicated vCPUs derived from 88 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 3892.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 22.11 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with 8192 GB of capacity, and the instance is premium storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple vectors. The multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and Passmark CPU tests ranks in the top 10%, aided by advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with both cached small-block and uncached large-block read operations placing in the top 10%. Database operations and Redis SET operations also achieve top-tier throughput, processing 169.15 million operations per second.

Given the massive memory footprint and high-speed local storage, this server is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, big data analytics, and heavy virtualization under Microsoft Hyper-V. The qualitative cost efficiency is characterized by high resource density, allowing consolidation of massive datasets that would otherwise require multi-node clustering, thereby reducing network overhead and simplifying infrastructure management.
